description: Find the fastest-growing recent video in a niche to clip — ClipSpeed's differentiator. Use when the user wants to grow a page or asks "what should I clip today". Pass a niche (e.g. 'AI tools'); omit to reuse the remembered niche. Returns a ranked pick plus candidates with velocity and channel-lift. Lead with the pick and the one-line reason, then offer to clip it.
name: discover_trending
